issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as missing GLTF files or network failures.
The skill contains verbose sections and multiple code examples that could be trimmed for brevity.
The skill is vendor-locked to React and Next.js, limiting its applicability to other AI agent platforms.

scenarios.name: interactive-rotating-box
scenarios.rationale: Response A satisfies every rubric requirement, while Response B lacks the required React components and hooks.

scenarios.name: animated-gltf-model
scenarios.rationale: Response A satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B omits preload, Suspense, and reset/fadeIn steps.

scenarios.rationale: Response A implements the required instancing logic but omits the <Canvas frameloop="demand"> wrapper, whereas Response B uses plain Three.js and lacks the React-specific Canvas and Instances components entirely.
